title: Developmental anatomy of the achene in Cannabis
scope: Cannabis achene development and mature fruit/seed anatomy, including pericarp, seed coat, embryo, cotyledons, and residual endosperm.

title: Correction to: Degeneration of oil bodies by rough endoplasmic reticulum (rER)-associated protein during seed germination in Cannabis sativa L.
scope: Published correction associated with the 2023 Cannabis seed-germination ultrastructure paper used in the controlled achene-anatomy package.

title: Structural Characteristics of Shells in a Fibrous Cultivar of Cannabis sativa L.
scope: Structural characterization of Cannabis achene shell tissues used as supporting evidence for distinguishing the fruit wall from internal seed tissues.

title: Morphometric Characterization of Hemp Achene and Leaf Trichomes Based on X-Ray Micro-CT
scope: X-ray micro-CT characterization of hemp achene morphology; useful for specimen-aware structural and morphometric context rather than universal dimensions.
